purpose: Narrow RESOLVED-INPUTS successor candidate for protocol v2. It supplies a recursively C-2-valid tag-10 ToolPath carrier, byte-bearing prepared-output commitment/transport join, exact handshake binding and deterministic host-owned subject/Coverage-domain construction without editing resolved-inputs.v2.json.

dependencyPins.use: closed rust-v1 universe, SnapshotId and PLAN-ID-V1 tag mapping
signed capability manifest and repository-execution promise
canonicalIdentifier, boundedParameterValue, exact stage and PlanId tag 10
relation ladder and universeRule inputs to deterministic Coverage construction

protocolReference.applicationRule: The protocol, both v2 joins, rejection response and retained v2 checker require exact-byte independent review and formal application as one dependency-locked set.

order: admit and freeze the exact per-project repository-execution grant and C-2-valid parameters in PlanIntent
if granted, run bounded network-disabled repository-resolution preparation outside the semantic sidecar
construct one closed byte-bearing PreparedOutputBlobV2 for each ordered build-script/proc-macro row
set each rust-v1 outputDigest to SHA-256 of that exact deterministic-CBOR blob and construct the complete closed rust-v1 value
compute and verify PlanId with rust-v1 in tag 9 and the unchanged admitted grants in tag 10
start the Rust semantic child immediately before its first admitted stage and transport every committed blob byte
repositoryExecutionPlanBinding.whyNoCycle: Tool selection booleans and logical tool paths are frozen before Snapshot in tag 10. Prepared bytes arise after Snapshot but before PlanId and are committed through tag-9 rust-v1 outputDigest rows. The semantic child starts after PlanId and cannot create either input.

defaultDisabled.semanticOutcomeWhenGeneratedCfgIsRequire: Unavailable observation with exhaustive provider-unavailable Coverage; host finalizer determines optional versus required D9 outcome

granted.grantProjectRule: grant.projectId exactly equals PlanIntent scope.projectId and Snapshot descriptor projectId
granted.outputRule: Every rust-v1 output row is produced exactly once, has one byte-bearing blob, and cannot be added, defaulted or replaced after PlanId.

c2BoundedParameterValuePin.canonicalByteMetric: maxTotalCanonicalBytes is measured as the exact opensip-canonical-json-v1 encoding defined by the pinned C-2 canonicalCommitment.encoding: NFC UTF-8, Unicode-scalar sorted object keys, no insignificant whitespace, shortest lowercase-required escapes and shortest signed integers.
c2BoundedParameterValuePin.recursiveRule: Validate every nested value and every nested map key, including each tool_paths element. Reject floats, bytes, non-NFC strings, out-of-signed-64 integers, excess depth/count/string/total canonical bytes, duplicate keys, unsorted canonical map encoding and any contribution-specific unknown key before attempt execution.

fields.tool_paths: array of ToolPathV2, strict ascending tuple (role UTF-8 bytes,bundle_relative_path UTF-8 bytes), unique; empty exactly when both execution booleans are false and non-empty otherwise

repositoryExecutionGrantParametersV2.c2Carrier: The exact recursively validated map is capabilityGrants[].parameters. PLAN-ID-V1 tag 10 CVE1 encodes the complete ordered grants array; no adapter projection or alternate spelling intervenes.
repositoryExecutionGrantParametersV2.unknownParameterRule: Reject before repository execution and PlanId construction.

fields.bundle_relative_path: non-empty NFC forward-slash relative path beneath the verified bundle; no leading slash, backslash, empty/dot/dot-dot segment, drive prefix or NUL
fields.file_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 characters of exact selected file bytes

c2KeyProof.rule: Each key matches the pinned canonicalIdentifier pattern; the complete record is within boundedParameterValue depth/map/string/type bounds.

toolPathV2.selectionRule: List every executable or loader selected by preparation. Missing, unused, outside-root or digest-mismatched entries reject before execution.
toolPathV2.physicalMapping: The host resolves bundle_relative_path beneath the verified absolute bundle root, rechecks containment and file_sha256, and never commits the machine-specific root.

planTag10ToWireBijection.planSource: PLAN-ID-V1 tag 10 capabilityGrants row whose grantId is OpenUniverse.repositoryResolution.grantId

fieldMap.rule: exact recursive equality and deterministic-CBOR byte equality; ToolPathV2 uses the same lowercase keys on both surfaces

planTag10ToWireBijection.reverseRule: Every wire ToolPathV2 has exactly one equal tag-10 element and every selected tag-10 tool path has exactly one wire element in identical order. Extra, missing, renamed or defaulted fields reject.
planTag10ToWireBijection.nonCarrierInputs: Prepared output bytes are post-Snapshot values and therefore do not mutate frozen tag 10; their exact commitment is tag 9 as specified below.

variants.build-script: kind=build-script; ownerId equals the exact rust-v1 row packageId; configuration equals its exact cfg array
variants.proc-macro: kind=proc-macro; ownerId equals the exact rust-v1 row crateId; configuration is the empty array

preparedOutputBlobV2.content: exact byte string, possibly empty; build-script content is the sealed host preparation output encoding and proc-macro content is the exact sealed binary
preparedOutputBlobV2.digestRule: The corresponding rust-v1 planRow.outputDigest equals lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact deterministic-CBOR PreparedOutputBlobV2 bytes. The blob contains no outputDigest or digest-derived path, so the recipe is direct and non-self-referential.
preparedOutputBlobV2.logicalPathAlgorithm: .opensip/prepared/v2/ + decimal outputOrdinal without leading zero + - + planRow.outputDigest + .blob

preparedOutputManifestBinding.orderedRows: rust-v1 buildScriptOutputs in their required order followed by procMacroOutputs in their required order
preparedOutputManifestBinding.entryDerivation: For ordinal i and its exact received blob, derive {outputOrdinal:i,kind,planRow,logicalPath,blobByteLength,blobSha256:planRow.outputDigest,contentByteLength,contentSha256}. blobByteLength counts exact final blob CBOR bytes; content fields count/hash exact content bytes.
preparedOutputManifestBinding.planIdProof: Tag 9 commits ordered rows and their blob digests. Each blob digest commits variant, owner/configuration and exact content; the row-to-blob equality rules bind that identity, and ordinal plus digest determines the path. Sizes and content digests are unique derivations from those bytes, so entries and manifestCommitment are uniquely determined by Plan-committed values plus verified bytes; no second manifest authority exists.
preparedOutputManifestBinding.wireProjection: OpenUniverse.repositoryResolution carries exact rust-v1 rows, tag-10 tool paths and manifestCommitment. PreparedOutputManifest carries the exact entries; chunks carry every final blob byte. All three reconstructions must agree.
preparedOutputManifestBinding.missingOrOpaqueRule: A metadata-only row without its bytes, digest-only fetch, hidden CAS, sidecar, file path, callback, external reference, duplicate/missing/reordered blob or mismatched byte/size/digest/manifest rejects before Analyze.

acceptedInputs: exact verified SnapshotId and SnapshotManifest entries
exact selected PLAN-ID-V1 tag-11 C-2 stages
hash-pinned FACT-PLANE relation ladders and universeRule values
analysisDomainBinding.subjectBinding: Every non-empty .rs snapshot file is one full-byte-range subject in path order; subject identity commits SnapshotId/path/content digest/length.
analysisDomainBinding.coverageBinding: For each exact stage relation, enumerate every FACT rung and every allowed target universe under the relation universeRule in the specified nested order.
analysisDomainBinding.planStageRule: The exact C-2 stage remains a nested unmodified planStage. Domain fields are a separate protocol-owned analysisDomain and are never private C-2 stage fields.
analysisDomainBinding.byteEquality: Fresh derivation A, independent derivation B and Analyze.analysisDomain deterministic-CBOR bytes must all be identical. Equal accepted inputs cannot choose another subject partition, rung, target set or key order.
analysisDomainBinding.failure: Empty/excess/ambiguous domain, unknown relation/rung, duplicate universe/key, mutated range/order/producer/version/schema or dependency mismatch rejects before child spawn.

fields.relations: exact non-empty closed string map from selected signed capability row

capabilityHandshakeBinding.planCommitment: rust-v1.capabilityManifestId names the exact signed capability manifest committed by PlanId.
hostValidationOrder: select exactly one rust-semantic capability row
require exact recursive HelloAck equality before OpenUniverse or source bytes
capabilityHandshakeBinding.mismatch: Terminate/reap, disclose no source, discard candidates and normalize provider-protocol through the conditional delivery join.

providerRequestProjection.disabled: mode=disabled, null grant/manifest commitment, exact projectId, network=false and empty output/tool arrays
providerRequestProjection.prepared: mode=prepared, exact grant/project, network=false, exact rust-v1 output rows, exact tag-10 lowercase ToolPathV2 array and exact reconstructed manifest commitment
providerRequestProjection.authorityRule: Provider may validate/consume sealed bytes only; it cannot execute project code, select tools, resolve another root, replace outputs, fetch content or broaden a grant.

changeRules: Changing a tool role/logical path/file digest/grant/project/execution boolean changes tag 10 and PlanId.
Changing a prepared kind/row/path/content changes its recipe digest in rust-v1 tag 9 and PlanId.
Changing a Snapshot entry, semantic universe, selected C-2 stage or provider build changes the deterministic request domain or its committed inputs.
No absolute root, installation prefix, temporary extraction directory or PATH order is a semantic input.
residuals: Formal integration into RESOLVED-INPUTS and DELIVERY is outside this candidate.
The host adapter, preparation runner, VFS and process enforcement remain unimplemented and unqualified.
Independent exact-byte review must verify C-2 recursion, direct non-self-referential blob commitment, tag-9/tag-10 proof and both domain derivations.
